title: A virtual screening investigation to identify bioactive natural compounds as potential inhibitors of cyclin-dependent kinase 9.
authors: Atiya, Akhtar; Shahidi, Habiba; Mohammad, Taj; Sharaf, Sharaf E; Abdulmonem, Waleed Al; Ashraf, Ghulam Md; Elasbali, Abdelbaset Mohamed; Alharethi, Salem Hussain; Alhumaydhi, Fahad A; Baeesa, Saleh Salem; Rehan, Mohd; Shamsi, Anas; Shahwan, Moyad
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和MD模拟寻找CDK9小分子抑制剂，虽涉及转录相关激酶但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Cyclin-dependent kinase 9 (CDK9) is a transcription-associated protein involved in controlling the cell cycle and is often deregulated in stress conditions. CDK9 is being studied as a well-known druggable target for developing effective therapeutics against a wide range of cancer, cardiac dysfunction and inflammatory diseases. Owing to the significance of CDK9 in the etiology of hematological and solid malignancies, its structure, biological activity, regulation and its pharmacological inhibition are being explored for therapeutic management of cancer. We employed a structure-based virtual high-throughput screening of bioactive compounds from the IMPPAT database to discover potential bioactive inhibitors of CDK9. The preliminary results were obtained from the Lipinski criteria, ADMET parameters and sorting compounds without any PAINS patterns. Subsequently, binding affinity and selectivity analyses were used to find effective CDK9 hits. This screening resulted in the identification of two natural compounds, Glabrene and Guggulsterone with high affinity and specificity for the CDK9 binding site. Both compounds exhibit drug-like characteristics, as projected by ADMET analysis, physicochemical data and PASS evaluation. Both compounds preferentially bind to the ATP-binding pocket of CDK9 and interact with functionally important residues. Further, the dynamics and consistency of CDK9 interaction with Glabrene and Guggulsteron were evaluated through all-atom molecular dynamic (MD) simulations which suggested the stability of both complexes. The results might be deployed to introduce novel CDK9 inhibitors that may treat life-threatening diseases, including cancer.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶9（CDK9）是一种与转录相关的蛋白质，参与调控细胞周期，并常在应激条件下失调。CDK9作为一种公认的可成药靶点，正在被研究用于开发针对多种癌症、心脏功能障碍和炎症性疾病的有效治疗药物。鉴于CDK9在血液系统恶性肿瘤和实体恶性肿瘤病因学中的重要性，其结构、生物活性、调控及其药理学抑制正在被探索用于癌症的治疗管理。我们采用基于结构的虚拟高通量筛选方法，从IMPPAT数据库中的生物活性化合物中寻找潜在的CDK9生物活性抑制剂。初步结果通过Lipinski规则、ADMET参数以及排除具有PAINS模式的化合物获得。随后，利用结合亲和力和选择性分析来寻找有效的CDK9命中化合物。该筛选识别出两种天然化合物，Glabrene和Guggulsterone，它们对CDK9结合位点具有高亲和力和特异性。这两种化合物均表现出药物样特性，如ADMET分析、理化数据和PASS评估所预测。两种化合物优先结合于CDK9的ATP结合口袋，并与功能重要的残基相互作用。此外，通过全原子分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟评估了CDK9与Glabrene和Guggulsterone相互作用的动态性和一致性，结果表明两种复合物均具有稳定性。这些结果可能用于引入新型CDK9抑制剂，以治疗包括癌症在内的危及生命的疾病。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
